aiSummary.title: AI Summary
aiSummary.description: Concise AI-generated summary of the visit for the record.

discussionTopics.title: Extracted Discussion Topics
discussionTopics.description: Semicolon-separated list of topics discussed during the visit. Extract drug names, clinical topics, and formulary discussions from the transcript (e.g. 'Keytruda; PD-L1 testing; formulary listing; dose escalation').

engagementScore.title: AI Engagement Score (0-100)
engagementScore.description: Engagement score 0-100 for the physician based on this visit.

needsReview.title: Needs Review Flag
needsReview.description: Set to True if the visit had unusual circumstances or compliance concerns. Default False.

nextBestAction.title: Next Best Action
nextBestAction.description: The single most important follow-up action the rep should take based on this visit (e.g. 'Send Keytruda clinical trial data to Dr. Sharma').

visitReportId.title: Visit Report ID
visitReportId.description: Salesforce ID of the visit report to update. Use the visitReportId output from log_visit.
